biography: Charles Milesi, born in Marseille, France, always felt the pull of the racetrack. His grandfather, a mechanic for rally teams in the '70s, instilled in him a love for engines and speed. Charles began karting at age eight, quickly outshining his peers with a natural feel for the kart. He recalls one early race in particular, where his kart's steering wheel broke mid-race; instead of giving up, he held the two broken pieces together and finished second. This tenacity became a hallmark of his career. Moving through the ranks, Charles faced setbacks – financial constraints nearly ended his dream several times. However, sheer determination and raw talent kept him afloat, eventually landing him a seat with Alpine. Now in his early thirties, Milesi is considered a reliable and consistent performer, a steady hand in the unpredictable world of motorsport, always striving to find that last tenth of a second.
drivingStyle: Milesi is known for his smooth, calculated driving style. He isn't one for flamboyant overtakes, but rather builds his pace throughout a race, conserving tires and exploiting his opponent's mistakes. He excels in wet conditions, demonstrating exceptional car control and an uncanny ability to find grip where others can't. His approach to corners is precise, focusing on maintaining momentum and minimizing wheelspin. Under pressure, Milesi remains remarkably calm, a trait that has served him well in endurance races.
